November 2026

Dear Our Esteemed Guest,

LETTER OF HEARTFELT APPRECIATION

Calvary greetings in the precious name of our Lord and Saviour, Jesus Christ.

On behalf of the Church Committee and the entire congregation of CCC Ijeshatedo Parish IV, we sincerely thank you for being part of our successful 2026 Adult Harvest Thanksgiving Celebration.

We are deeply grateful for honouring our invitation, your generous financial support, prayers, encouragement and every other contribution towards the success of the celebration. Your kindness and commitment to the work of God mean so much to us.

May the Almighty God richly reward your generosity, replenish your resources, grant you divine favour and bless you and your household with an overflowing harvest of joy, peace and prosperity.

Thank you once again for celebrating and supporting us. May your harvest of blessings never cease, in Jesus’ name. Amen.

With heartfelt gratitude,

For: The Church Committee
CCC Ijeshatedo Parish IV
